professionalSummary: Programme Manager of Record for a deposit platform migration at a retail bank (2022‑2025), responsible for signing the programme charter and all wave go/no‑go submissions to the executive steering committee.
Holder of current PgMP (since 2021) and PMP (since 2016) credentials, with registry entries available for verification.
Managed the migration programme budget within the bank’s delegated limits, reporting quarterly to the steering committee.
Directed four project managers across migration waves using the bank’s documented programme method, conducting weekly wave reviews and monthly programme boards.
Authored programme boundary statements, risk register summaries, and hand‑over conditions for each of the five programme gates.
experienceHighlights: Programme Manager of Record, Deposit Platform Migration, Retail Bank (2022‑2025) – charter signing, wave go/no‑go approvals, budget stewardship, PM leadership, gate documentation.
Project Manager, Payments Programmes, Retail Bank (2018‑2022) – led multiple payment initiatives.
PgMP Credential holder (2021‑present) – certified by PMI.
PMP Credential holder (2016‑present) – certified by PMI.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Signed wave go/no‑go submission with steering committee decision record (work sample).
PgMP and PMP credential certificates (work sample).
